name: Roosteroverzicht Traffic Bridge
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'set -e; cd bridge && npm install; sudo apt-get update; sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y curl ca-certificates gnupg; sudo install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings; curl -fsSL https://packages.microsoft.com/keys/microsoft.asc | gpg --dearmor | sudo tee /etc/apt/keyrings/microsoft-edge.gpg >/dev/null; sudo chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/microsoft-edge.gpg; echo "deb [arch=amd64 signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/microsoft-edge.gpg] https://packages.microsoft.com/repos/edge stable main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/microsoft-edge-stable.list >/dev/null; sudo apt-get update; sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y microsoft-edge-stable'
postStartCommand: bash -lc 'if ! curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8787/api/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then nohup env PORT=8786 npm --prefix bridge start >/tmp/traffic-bridge.log 2>&1 & sleep 2; nohup env HANDOFF_PROXY_PORT=8787 TRAFFIC_BRIDGE_UPSTREAM_PORT=8786 node bridge/handoff-proxy.js >/tmp/traffic-handoff-proxy.log 2>&1 & fi; sleep 2; if command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -n "$CODESPACE_NAME" ]; then gh codespace ports visibility 8787:public -c "$CODESPACE_NAME" || true; fi'
